sourceMode: Unified live actor source; legacy projected-shadow passes suppressed
sampling: 32 distributed vertices plus strongest-weight representative of every used joint, deduplicated; detailed GPU matrix separately checks every vertex
scope: Every authored key and interval midpoint at eight runtime headings; original post-process alpha and the matching evaluated skin matrices. Detailed field casting/reception is a separate GPU report; this is not an exhaustive test of continuous real-valued time.
